odc_type: Type safety violation in comparison logic
observation_summary: The compareTo method returns 0 (indicating equality) when comparing two different enum types that share the same underlying integer value, instead of throwing a ClassCastException.
reasoning_summary: The bug exists because the compareTo method in ValuedEnum performed a direct subtraction of integer values without verifying that the objects being compared belonged to the same class. This allowed two different enum types that happened to share the same integer value to be considered equal, violating type safety. The fix introduces a class check to ensure that only instances of the same enum class (or compatible classes loaded by different classloaders) are compared, throwing a ClassCastException otherwise.
